title: Locker Rental: monthly rate and membership discount by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers (Small Locker, Medium Locker, Large Locker, Premium Climate-Controlled Locker, Day-Use Locker, VIP Locker Suite), the recurring monthly rental fee and the membership discount percentage that is set for that tier. The membership discount percentage is the reduction taken off the tier's monthly fee for a member holding a qualifying club membership tier; the basis on which that reduction is actually applied to a charge is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Monthly rate and membership discount table
| Tier | Monthly fee | Member discount |
|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | $10.00 | 0 percent |
| Medium Locker | $15.00 | 0 percent |
| Large Locker | $22.00 | 5 percent |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | $35.00 | 10 percent |
| Day-Use Locker | not billed monthly (billed by the day; see the Locker Rental daily-use terms) | 0 percent |
| VIP Locker Suite | $55.00 | 20 percent |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- What is the monthly fee for a Medium Locker? Fifteen dollars.
- Which tier carries the highest monthly fee? The VIP Locker Suite, at fifty-five dollars a month.
- Which tier carries the highest member discount? The VIP Locker Suite, at twenty percent.
- Does the Small Locker tier carry any member discount? No; its member discount is fixed at zero percent.

## Points of judgement
A member discount of zero percent, as fixed for the Small Locker, Medium Locker and Day-Use Locker tiers, means no reduction is available off that tier's monthly fee regardless of the member's club membership tier. Only the Large Locker, Premium Climate-Controlled Locker and VIP Locker Suite tiers carry a nonzero member discount percentage as a fixed tier value.
